That reads as hedged, so it is closer to N. Even so, "better-documented figure is 650" does signal a preference for B.

The decision rule says that a reply giving B "even if it adds a caveat" counts as B. Here, though, the reply's primary stance is "unresolved," and the preference is only a soft lean. I'll go with N.
